liebermann.description_de: Verlorene Vorlage von S und Pl
liebermann.shelfmark_as_given: Posited by Liebermann: a common source of S and Pl, inferred from the readings they share. No such manuscript survives.
liebermann.laws: ECf, Lib Lond, In Cn, Wl art
liebermann.notes: A common source of S and Pl for ECf (with rubrics from ECf retr), Libertas Londoniensis, Instituta Cnuti (Ip Hunt class) and the Tripartita (Wl art, Genealogia Normannica continued to John), posited by Liebermann.

others.text: O’Brien (2003): O’Brien’s family tree has the same common source of S and Pl (his ι), and below it a second lost manuscript (π) behind Pl, Vincent 98 and Harley 785.
